verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail is a hosted virtual-mailbox service. It is software-backed, so the openness question of self-hosting fairly applies, but the evidence pack never mentions a self-hostable or on-premises deployment. The developer page offers only a hosted API and Zapier integration, which are integration options, not self-hosting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
